title: calendar-ref v1 (blob)
description: Which calendar of the provider a `schedule.calendar_sync_changed` v1 event is about. A blob (`application/vnd.campbooks.calendar-ref+json; version=1`) that event points at: the provider's calendar id can be an address, so it never travels in an event. Deleted with the workspace.

provider_calendar_id.description: The calendar's id at the provider.
